description: This Java source file defines a deserializer component for processing JSON data related to 'code values' in the Apache Fineract project. It handles validation and parsing of JSON input for creating and updating code value entities, supporting operations like checking for unsupported parameters, extracting fields, and validating their values.

classes.name: CodeValueCommandFromApiJsonDeserializer
classes.description: A final class marked as a Spring component, responsible for deserializing and validating JSON input for creating and updating code value entities within the Fineract API.

methods.name: validateForCreate
methods.description: Validates and processes JSON input for creating a new code value, checking for required fields, supported parameters, and data types.

methods.name: validateForUpdate
methods.description: Validates and processes JSON input for updating an existing code value, similar to create validation but allowing partial updates.

methods.name: throwExceptionIfValidationWarningsExist
methods.description: Throws a validation exception if any validation errors have been accumulated.
